hash_algorithm: FNV-1a 32-bit via Hecton.Localization.LocHash.Compute (UTF-16 code units, case-preserving)

power_model.thermal_conditioning_formula: mass_kg * (specific_heat_kj_per_kg_k * process_delta_k + latent_heat_kj_per_kg * phase_change_fraction) / kilojoules_per_kwh / thermal_efficiency * reactivation_fraction
power_model.surface_joining_formula: sphere_area_from_mass_density * (1 + surface_complexity_per_tier * tier) * surface_join_kj_per_m2 / kilojoules_per_kwh / arc_surface_coupling_efficiency

time_model.formula: FabricationTimeSeconds = base_chamber_purge_seconds + tier * tier_calibration_seconds + input_mass_kg * mass_feed_seconds_per_kg + baseline_cost_units * value_inspection_seconds_per_unit

starter_edge_model.formula: total_minutes = collection_minutes + fabrication_seconds / seconds_per_minute + PowerCost_kWh / starter_generator_kw * seconds_per_minute

toaster.presentation: shared fabricator hum, no per-recipe particles

god_mode.presentation: dirty hydraulic arcs, resin smoke puffs, harmonic motor wobble
